title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran defends Chandayatha from rogues and reassures her. Nadesan chats with Nila over tea, while Aravind closes shop and invites Vannathi and Selvam to a movie.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Bagyaraj Promises to Stand by Malar
description: Bagyaraj lashes out at Suresh for Malar leaving home and insists he apologise to her. He seeks Malar's forgiveness, vows to stand by her, and persuades her to return home with him.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi and Aishwarya rely on recorded evidence to prove Sethupathi innocent. Meanwhile, Eshwari grows suspicious of Aishwarya for mimicking her voice to deceive Abinav.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: As Kandhasamy surprises Kumaran-Sarasu, Shanmugam meets Abhi to discuss their register marriage. Indhira catches their public notice and asks them to get family approval first.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil ruins the travel business, forcing Raji to recall Kathir. Upset, Senthil drinks and returns home drunk to a furious Pandian.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini invites Vijaya to her parlour opening while Muthu gets a car auction idea from Selvam. Ravi is shocked as Vasudevan secretly adds a testosterone test to his blood report.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri informs Shanmugam of Abinaya's poor health, and they plot to stop her from overworking. However, their protective plan gets exposed when she uncovers Shanmugam's act.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Meenatchi confronts Poongodi for calling her 'Atha' and refuses to accept their relationship. Meanwhile, Poongodi mocks Azhagar for coming home heavily drunk.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Sidharth challenges Paraman to win the election, while Paraman receives financial support. Viji's blessings stir his emotions, as Kalamma tries to win voters over with money.
